discipline: All predictions below were written BEFORE any experiment run. Receipt files carry mtimes >= this file's mtime. Honest FAIL = real result.

experiments.subject: quilt-mesh bazaar (mesh/bazaar.mjs), 2 minds x (6 solo + 4 trade gens) x 8 cands

claims.claim: bazaar exits 0 and its fnv-1a-64 receipt chain verifies from the written outputs/bazaar_receipts.json; a second identical run reproduces the SAME seal (determinism)
claims.falsified_if: exit != 0, chain verify fails, or seals differ across two runs

claims.claim: each mind ends with >=3 bloodline doctrines after trade while the solo control stays capped at 2 (Poly-GAN effect: trade, not time, adds blood)
claims.falsified_if: any mind ends with <3 doctrines or solo control >2

claims.claim: immune system weaves a FRACTION of traded patches: woven/attempted in [0.2, 0.8] (not a rubber stamp, not a wall)

experiments.subject: ported Lamport/version-vector anti-entropy mesh per quilt-mesh src/lib.rs protocol sketch (their semantics, my JS port) — 3 peers, 12 set() events, 3 rooms, random gossip delays, 20 sims

claims.claim: all 3 peers converge to IDENTICAL merged cell state in every sim; median rounds-to-convergence <= 10 and max <= 30 gossip rounds
claims.falsified_if: any sim fails to converge or max rounds > 30

claims.claim: zero lost updates: final state at every peer is exactly the union of all 12 emitted events (idempotent dedupe by (lamport, author) holds)
claims.falsified_if: any final state missing or differing from the union

claims.claim: causal observation: every peer's Lamport clock at end >= max emitted event lamport
claims.falsified_if: any peer clock < max event lamport

experiments.subject: ropesight method schedule (Plain Bob Minor, stage 6, one 60-row plain course via their bells/methods.mjs) vs 60-row cyclic round-robin as lane-assignment schedules

claims.claim: pair-coverage: distinct ordered adjacent pairs ('who follows whom') after 60 rows — method covers 30/30 (fallback registered: >=18/30) while round-robin covers exactly 6/30
meeting balance over met pairs: method per-pair meeting count max/min <= 2.0 across 60 rows

turn-fairness (lead position gets the resource): for M=37 rows, round-robin max deviation |count - M/6| <= 1 and method <= 2 — i.e. methods buy PAIR diversity, not better turn fairness (expected honest negative for methods on this metric)
claims.falsified_if: method beats round-robin on max deviation, or either exceeds its stated bound

claims.claim: gap burstiness: in the method schedule every met pair's max inter-meeting gap <= 120 rows (2x course period); round-robin's 6 met pairs meet exactly every 6 rows
claims.falsified_if: any method pair gap >120 or RR pair gap != 6

experiments.subject: loom-core foundry: bin/loom.mjs run examples/witness-fnv.mjs --gens 12 --seed 7 (GAN over logic, mech voice only, zero keys)

claims.claim: exit 0, witness chain VERIFIED at end, and EVERY crowned elite is born-correct (passed the forge's adversarial probes) — validity of crowned logic = 100%
claims.falsified_if: exit != 0, chain fails, or any crowned elite fails the oracle

claims.claim: archive saturation is temporal: all distinct crowned families appear by gen 4 (DRIFT.md's early-crowns finding reproduces on a fresh 12-gen run)
claims.falsified_if: a new family is crowned after gen 4

claims.claim: mimic pressure is the bulk of the population: mimic count >= 60 of ~96 candidates over 12 gens
